title: 课程与研究词汇
goal: 辨认课程与研究词汇，区分研究及提交环节的相关概念。

points.label: 辨认课程与研究的常用词
区分研究与提交环节的相关概念

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 课程与研究词汇及教学规格

body.p: 课程与研究的讨论常涉及四类话题：考核、检索、研究方法和报告提交。判断词义时，要看句中的任务和动作。

body.box: The student collects responses through a questionnaire. The tutor comments on the first draft before the final version is submitted.

body.p: questionnaire 是收集回答的工具。first draft 是初稿，还要修改。final version 是最后提交的定稿。

cards.title: 词汇表：课程考核
cards.note: coursework 是课程中完成的作业，examination 是考试。feedback 是反馈意见，grade 是成绩等级或分数。

cards.title: 词汇表：资料检索
cards.note: catalogue 列出图书馆的馆藏，database 收录可检索的文献记录。source 是用到的资料，reference 是写明这份资料出处的条目。

cards.title: 词汇表：研究方法
cards.note: questionnaire 用书面问题收集回答，interview 当面交谈提问。population 是研究针对的整个群体，sample 是从中选出的一部分。

cards.title: 词汇表：报告提交
cards.note: draft 还要修改，final version 是定稿。deadline 是截止时间，extension 是准许推迟提交。

body.box:
Student: I've written the first draft. Should I submit it now?
Tutor: Send it to me for feedback first. Then revise it and submit the final version by Friday.

What will the student submit by Friday?
1. The tutor's feedback
2. The revised final version
3. The first draft without revision
4. The first draft with the feedback attached

body.p: 依据是 Then revise it and submit the final version by Friday。初稿先交导师提意见，修改后的定稿才在周五提交，即第二项。

lines.text: Please complete the questionnaire before our interview.
I'll answer the written questions first.

items.stem: What will the participant complete first?
options: Both parts at the same time
items.why: 依据是 complete the questionnaire before our interview。先做的是书面问卷，即第一项。

lines.text: The tutor gave me feedback on my assignment.
Did the comments help you revise it?

options: The tutor's comments on the assignment
The revised version of the assignment
The tutor's own revision of the assignment
items.why: 对方接着用 the comments 指代 feedback。feedback 是导师对作业的意见，即第二项。

lines.text: The deadline is Friday, but I received an extension until Monday.
Then you have the weekend to finish.

options: The due date moves from Monday to Friday
The student must finish before the weekend
The student has longer to submit the work
The weekend is no longer free for the work
items.why: 依据是 The deadline is Friday, but I received an extension until Monday。截止日从周五推到周一，提交时间变长，即第三项。

lines.text: I've searched the library catalogue for books on assessment. I also searched a database for journal articles.
Good. Record a reference for each source you use, and include the author's name.
I'll check the references before submitting the report.

items.stem: Where did the student search for journal articles?
options: In the library catalogue, with the books
In the references listed in the report
In the reference lists of other articles
In a database, not the library catalogue
items.why: 依据是 I also searched a database for journal articles。图书馆目录用来找书，期刊文章是在数据库里找的，即第四项。

items.stem: What should the student record for each source?
options: A reference that identifies the source
Only the name of each source's author
A catalogue search for each book used
A list of sources checked after submission
items.why: 依据是 Record a reference for each source。每份资料都要记一条写明出处的条目，即第一项。第二项只说了作者姓名，那只是条目的一部分。

items.stem: What information should a reference include here?
options: The database where the article was found
The name of the person who wrote it
The date the report will be submitted
The catalogue number of each book
items.why: 依据是 include the author's name。导师要求条目写上作者姓名，即第二项。

items.stem: A student enters a word into a database to find articles on feedback. What is that word called?
items.why: 检索时输入的词是关键词，即 keyword。第三项 database 是检索的地方，不是输入的词。

items.stem: A tutor gives comments on a report and later awards a grade. Which term refers to the comments?
items.why: 导师写的意见是 feedback。grade 和 mark 都指分数。

items.stem: A researcher selects twenty students from all students on a course. What is the selected group called?
items.why: 从全体学生中选出的一部分是 sample。第一项 population 指全体学生。

items.stem: A report lists detailed supporting material after the main text. What is that section called?
items.why: 正文之后收录补充材料的部分是附录，即 appendix。第二项 abstract 是正文前的摘要。

items.stem: A student searches a library's list of its books. What is that list called?
items.why: 列出图书馆藏书的目录是 library catalogue。第三项 database 收录的是文章记录。

items.stem: A student writes a first draft, revises it and submits the final version. Which is submitted?
options: A list of the revisions made
items.why: 修改之后提交的是定稿，即 final version。第一项是修改前的初稿。

lines.text: I've prepared a questionnaire about how students use the study rooms. It asks them to write which rooms they use and why. I'm considering interviews as well, because I could ask follow-up questions about their written answers.

That would be useful. First define the population: are you interested in everyone on the course, or only students who have used the rooms? Then select a sample from that group. Explain that choice in the methods section.
I'll focus on everyone on the course, and select a smaller group to answer the questionnaire. I'll invite some of those participants for interviews afterwards.

items.stem: What is the purpose of the interviews?
options: To define the population of the study
To select the sample from the course
To ask more about the written answers
items.why: 依据是 I could ask follow-up questions about their written answers。访谈用来追问问卷上的回答，即第四项。访谈是在问卷之后加做的，不取代问卷。

items.stem: What does the tutor mean by ‘population’ here?
options: The whole group the study is about
Only the students invited to interviews
items.why: 依据是 Then select a sample from that group。population 是研究针对的整个群体，样本从中选出，即第一项。第二项说的是样本。

lines.text: I've drafted my report on seminar participation. The outline helped me put the sections in order, but I haven't added the references yet. I used two journal articles and a chapter from a book.
Make sure every source has a complete reference. Check the author's name and publication details against the source itself. Then send me the draft for feedback before you prepare the final version.
I'll check those details tonight. The submission deadline is next Friday, so there should be time to revise the draft after receiving your comments. I'll include the additional table in an appendix.

items.stem: What will the tutor provide before the final version?
options: A check of each author's details
items.why: 依据是 send me the draft for feedback before you prepare the final version。导师先对草稿提意见，即第二项。核对引用条目是学生自己的事。

items.stem: What must the student check against each source?
options: The order of the sections in the outline
The figures in the additional table
Who wrote it and where it was published
The comments received on the draft
items.why: 依据是 Check the author's name and publication details against the source itself。要核对的是作者和出版信息，即第三项。
